description: Implementation of a service class 'SqlInjectionPreventerServiceImpl' that provides methods to escape SQL literals and quote identifiers for different database types (MySQL and PostgreSQL), aiming to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities.

classes.name: SqlInjectionPreventerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing SQL injection prevention methods for escaping literals and quoting identifiers based on database type.

methods.name: encodeSql
methods.description: Encodes a SQL literal string based on the database type, escaping it appropriately for MySQL or PostgreSQL.

methods.name: escapeMySQLLiteral
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string literal for safe inclusion in MySQL/MariaDB SQL queries.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier
methods.description: Quotes a database identifier, validating it and applying database-specific quoting rules.
